item.group_name: Short video from a picture or text
item.title: Make My Photo Reel Fun

turns.text: Turn these five pics into an 8-second vertical reel. Make it fun! You pick the vibe.

item.tests: Checks whether the agent turns a vague creative brief into a visibly playful photo reel without unnecessary clarification.
must_haves: One playable vertical reel runs for approximately 8 seconds.
All five attached photos appear recognizably: the golden retriever, shocked cat, beach friends, curly-haired woman and mountain lake.
The edit includes visible playful treatment, such as bouncy motion, comic timing, lively transitions or humorous overlays, rather than only static slides.
Faces and the pets remain recognizable and are not obscured throughout their appearances.
The result is a single edited sequence, not five separate clips or a contact sheet.

turns.text: Turn these five attached pics—the dog, the surprised cat, the two friends, the woman’s portrait, and the lake—into an 8-second vertical reel. Make it fun! You pick the vibe. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
**Nothing has been generated, and no credits have been spent.**

My pick: a playful **“cute → chaos → good times → calm”** reel:
**Dog 2s → surprised cat 1s → friends 2s → portrait 1s → lake 2s**, vertical **9:16**.

| Option | Cost | Trade-off |
|---|---:|---|
| **8-second photo slideshow** | **0 generation credits** | Quick cuts between original photos; no AI subject movement |
| **8-second AI-animated montage, 480p** | **192 credits estimated** | Five animated shots at the production tool’s listed 24 credits/second; sound excluded |
| **5-second AI montage, 480p** | **120 credits estimated** | One second per photo; faster pacing |

**Cheapest recommendation:** keep the full 8 seconds as a silent slideshow, then add music in your social app. For AI animation, 480p is already the smallest supported free-plan video setting; shortening saves credits.

One limitation: the zero-credit slideshow assembler needs downloadable image URLs, but these attachments provide account file paths. I can’t assemble that option directly from those paths with the available tool.

Would you prefer **the zero-credit slideshow route** (with downloadable links supplied), or **AI animation at the estimated cost**? I won’t start a paid generation without your approval.
dialog.user: ok, go ahead with that—the zero-credit 8-second slideshow route.

dialog.agent:
The **8-second slideshow will use 0 generation credits**, with no AI animation or sound.

I still need **direct downloadable URLs for the five images**. The slideshow tool can’t read the Magic Hour file paths attached here, and I can’t convert them to URLs with the available tools.

Please send those links, and I’ll assemble:
**Dog 2s → cat 1s → friends 2s → portrait 1s → lake 2s**, in **9:16 vertical**.

Nothing has run or spent credits.
dialog.user: I only have the five attached pictures. Is there a way to use those for the zero-credit slideshow without downloadable links?

dialog.agent:
**Yes—using a free video editor on your phone or computer, with no downloadable links needed.** However, I can’t assemble it here: the zero-credit slideshow tool requires URLs, and the available tools can’t retrieve them from your attached files. Sorry I offered that route before checking this limitation.

To make it free in CapCut, iMovie, or another local editor:

1. Save the five attached pictures to your device.
2. Start a **9:16 vertical** project.
3. Arrange and time them:
   - **Dog:** 2 seconds
   - **Surprised cat:** 1 second
   - **Friends:** 2 seconds
   - **Woman’s portrait:** 1 second
   - **Lake:** 2 seconds
4. Use quick cuts and a gentle zoom on the cat for the comic beat.
5. Fit the photos rather than cropping out either friend; export at **720p** for a smaller file.

That keeps all five photos, runs exactly **8 seconds**, and uses **zero Magic Hour credits**. Nothing has been generated or charged here.
dialog.user: ok, go ahead with the cheapest option you listed

turns.agent:
The cheapest option is **the zero-credit slideshow in a free editor**, but I can’t operate an external editor or assemble it here from these attachment paths. **Nothing has run or spent credits.**

To make it on your device, save the attachments and import them into CapCut or iMovie:

**Dog 2s → cat 1s → friends 2s → portrait 1s → lake 2s**

Set the canvas to **9:16**, use hard cuts, and export at **720p**. Fit each photo inside the frame so neither friend gets cropped out.

Tell me whether you’re on **iPhone, Android, or computer**, and I’ll give you the shortest exact steps.
